title: Compare European conditional lookup in Ability scene
changes: Add an opt-in assertion to the existing scene differential that requires reads of both fields of the conditional lookup.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine comparison passed 540 complete state/clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio frames; the same run served 55 lookup bytes from both fields with guarded inputs and sources unchanged.
limitations: Both arms use the same native cache; other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
